answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 43330 Country: India Title: Meaning of Name Question: I referred few Islamic name websites and named my girl baby as Aisha Manha. In those sites Manha was referred as "Allah's Gift". Is it right meaning? Please advise, if the name is proper. Answer ID: 43330 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 172/143/N=1434) As per the Arabic dictionary Minha (منحۃ) means gift, present and boon. It does not mean especially the gift of Allah but if you mean it is allowable. Thus Ayesha Minha name is correct. You can keep this name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
